roles.name: Game Manager
roles.does: Foreman: triages ideas, routes work, unsticks stalled ideas, checkpoint commits.

roles.name: Lead Designer
roles.does: Game loop, feature specs, quest structure, ROADMAP and spec tree.

roles.name: Narrative
roles.does: Story, lore, characters, quest and dialogue text.

roles.name: Engineering
roles.does: Server/client Luau, persistence, remotes, performance, Studio sync tooling.

roles.name: Balance
roles.does: Economy, progression, drop rates and combat tuning in Config.luau.

roles.name: Art Director
roles.does: Look and feel, lighting, prefabs, UI theme, Blender meshes, icons.

roles.name: Audio
roles.does: Music, ambience, SFX, the mix and audio hooks.

roles.name: Head of QA
roles.does: Play-mode tests, regressions, bug triage, release checklist.

roles.name: Factory Engineer
roles.does: Studies past runs and improves the Factory itself; builds ideas in the Factory area (its prompts, loops, routing, docs).

loops.name: Morning triage
loops.prompt: Morning triage. 1) Call factory_status and list_ideas. 2) Triage every idea still in the inbox (set area, kind, task_type, owner_role, priority, needs_spec and the approval verdict with update_idea). 3) Look for ideas stuck in one stage for more than a day and unstick them (send_note to the owner role, or update_idea to on_hold with a reason). 4) Finish with a five-line summary of the factory's state.

loops.name: Idea scouting
loops.prompt: Idea scouting. Read ROADMAP.md (only the sections you need) and list_ideas to avoid duplicates. Propose at most 3 ideas with propose_idea that move the current pass forward. Prefer ideas that serve an existing owner idea or ROADMAP item and pass its id as parent_id. Brand-new systems or modes are fine to propose, but they will wait for the owner's approval. Do not start building anything.

loops.name: Nightly QA regression
loops.prompt: Nightly regression. Claim Roblox Studio, run the standard new-player regression in Play mode on the current build, and release Studio when done. For every new bug, call propose_idea with kind 'bug', a clear repro and the suspected owner area; update team/BUGS.md as usual. Finish with a pass/fail summary.

loops.name: Checkpoint commit
loops.prompt: Checkpoint. Run node tools/verify.mjs. Using factory_status, find files touched by finished runs that are still uncommitted (git status); never commit a file a live run has claimed or is editing. Commit the finished files with a message crediting the roles. If verify fails, propose_idea a kind 'bug' describing the failure instead of committing.

loops.name: Commit steward
loops.prompt: Commit steward (catches work left uncommitted after a denied commit). 1) Call who_is_using for git; if another run holds it, end with a one-line status and do not retry. 2) Run git status --porcelain; if clean, say so and stop. 3) Call factory_status for claimed files and live runs. Never commit a file a live run has claimed or is editing. 4) Find uncommitted paths that finished runs left behind: recent update_idea notes (get_idea on ideas in qa or shipped that mention uncommitted paths) and team/logs/. 5) Per role, make one commit of just that role's finished files: git commit -m "<role>: <what> (#id)" -- <paths> (never git add -A; skip paths you cannot attribute and list them in your summary). Run node tools/verify.mjs first only if place/ or tools/ files are included; if it fails, commit nothing and propose_idea kind 'bug'. If the commit is denied, stop: that is final for this run and the next tick retries. Finish with a two-line summary: committed paths, skipped paths.

loops.name: Game Bible refresh
loops.prompt: Game Bible refresh. Read docs/bible/README.md. Compare docs/bible/changelog.md with the newest ROADMAP.md section 4.5 rows and the ideas finished since its last entry (list_ideas level "idea" status "shipped"). Add any missing days to the changelog, newest first, in plain words. Then fix any section of docs/bible/ that is now out of date (new creatures, items, bosses, features or story). Keep it accurate: facts come from docs/content/, Config.luau and the specs. Commit only docs/bible/ files. If nothing changed, say so and stop.

loops.name: Factory self-review
loops.prompt: Factory self-review. Run node factory/tools/digest.mjs --days 3 and study it. Find what wasted time or tokens, what got redone and why, which tool gates blocked work, and which instructions agents keep missing. Make at most 3 focused improvements (CLAUDE.md 'Learned rules', an agent definition, factory/factory.config.json routing or loops, or factory/prompts). Commit each change separately and call record_improvement for each with the evidence. If nothing is worth changing, say so.

triage.why: Routing decisions over short idea text; Sonnet is reliable and cheap enough.

spec-design.why: Design specs need reasoning but not 3D work (owner tier rule).

story-text.why: Rule-bound writing; owner tier rule: Haiku or Sonnet for text.

balance-config.why: Numbers plus reasoning about curves (owner tier rule).

luau-client.why: Client modules and UI code (owner tier rule).

ui-client.why: UI layout and client code (owner tier rule).

world-geometry.why: Spatial work: world layout, terrain, the bake (owner tier rule).

blender-mesh.why: 3D modelling, rigs and textures (owner tier rule).

audio.why: Audio hooks and mix settings (owner tier rule).

qa-playtest.why: Multi-step Play-mode testing and triage (owner tier rule).

factory-review.why: Analysis of run digests; not art or 3D (owner tier rule).

ops-commit.why: Run verify and commit finished files; mechanical.
